title: jev_judge.py batch request line
description: One JSON object per line of the batch input (stdin or --input; the same parser reads both). Each line pairs one item with one anchor and the candidate question sets to judge it with; batch sends one Jev request per (item, candidate, repeat). The low layer is tracker-neutral: bead-batch builds these lines from beads, and the tournament builds them from its oracle and candidates. A line without anchor (a judge-jev quality wave, where the record is the item) sends only the item, needs no roles and gets a null verdict.

anchor.description: Jev sees id, statement and scope; kind (directive, prohibition, structural) sets how the verdict is read.

location.description: The location under evaluation, as the location string of judge-jev check (path, path#Heading or path::Symbol). Goes into the state as location. Optional.

definitions.description: Definitions the request carries in its state next to the item (ADR-JEV-0008, REQ-JEV-0212), term order. Absent when no definition applies, so such a request is as before. Never truncated.

questions.description: Candidates; candidate_id is unique within the line.
The complete question set sent to Jev, keyed by question id.

roles.description: Role -> question id; default the --gate question set's roles.
